title: Use provider finish reasons for bounded tool-loop termination
objective: Make automatic v2 tool orchestration continue or stop from an explicit provider-normalized decision derived from provider-specific finish_reason metadata instead of inferring termination from an empty tool-call collection.

branch.name: wi-0003-llm-finish-reason-termination
branch.rationale: The work item is processed as a serial set of scoped commits on the current repository branch; the branch name records the intended change boundary without requiring a topic branch.

request.text:
OK -- prepare a new .docs/work-items/* that takes into account provider specific finish_reason, update the ProviderCompletionResponse as indicated. commit the new work item.

Process the work item until completion, making commits as you go.

scope.name: provider-finish-reason-termination
scope.description: Parse OpenRouter finish_reason metadata, normalize it into an explicit ProviderCompletionResponse decision, and make automatic tool orchestration continue only for tool_calls and stop only for stop.
scope.reason: The current loop treats an empty tool-call collection as an implicit stop and loses the provider's explicit termination signal.

nonGoals.name: v1-contract-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not change llm/request/v1 or llm/response/v1 fields or behavior.
nonGoals.reason: The existing v1 contracts are closed public compatibility boundaries.

nonGoals.name: new-model-envelope
nonGoals.description: Do not introduce a second application-level JSON decision envelope or a new terminal control tool.
nonGoals.reason: OpenRouter already exposes an OpenAI-compatible provider termination field that can be normalized at the adapter boundary.

nonGoals.name: provider-expansion
nonGoals.description: Do not add live providers, streaming support, provider retries beyond the existing bounded retry path, persistence, or real external tool execution.
nonGoals.reason: This change only makes the existing OpenRouter v2 loop consume explicit termination metadata.

items.name: normalized-provider-decision
items.description: ProviderCompletionResponse includes a required provider-neutral decision that represents whether the model selected continuation or termination.
items.reason: The orchestration layer needs an explicit control signal rather than deriving lifecycle state from tool-call collection length.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The exported ProviderCompletionResponse type requires decision: 'continue' | 'stop', and deterministic injected-provider tests compile and exercise both decisions.

items.name: openrouter-finish-reason-mapping
items.description: The OpenRouter adapter maps choices[0].finish_reason='tool_calls' to continue and finish_reason='stop' to stop, while rejecting missing or unsupported termination values.
items.reason: Provider-specific response metadata must be translated once at the provider boundary and must not leak into orchestration policy.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Mocked fetch tests verify tool_calls and stop mappings, and verify missing, null, and unsupported finish reasons fail closed without being interpreted from message.tool_calls length.

items.name: explicit-bounded-loop-control
items.description: Automatic v2 orchestration continues only when decision is continue with at least one tool-call batch, stops only when decision is stop, and rejects contradictory combinations.
items.reason: The model-selected termination decision must be the authoritative loop control while existing tool, round, retry, and v1 compatibility bounds remain intact.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tests prove explicit stop terminates after tool results, explicit continue invokes tools, continue without calls fails closed, stop with calls fails closed, and existing v1/v2 regression tests remain passing.

items.name: termination-documentation
items.description: The public package documentation explains the provider-specific finish_reason mapping and states that empty tool-call collections do not determine automatic-loop termination.
items.reason: The termination decision is part of the provider boundary and must be discoverable by consumers and adapter authors.

acceptanceCriteria.description: SKILL.md documents choices[0].finish_reason, the tool_calls/stop mapping, the fail-closed invalid combinations, and the distinction between ProviderCompletionResponse and terminal LlmResponseV2.
